## Safety and publication checklist

- [ ] I did not stage saves, `qa_runs/`, `agent_runs/`, local settings, secrets,
      personal media, or unrelated dirty files.
- [ ] Public claims match the implementation and distinguish tests, diagnostics,
      research, and accepted runtime evidence.
- [ ] New links and authored media pass the repository presentation validator.
- [ ] Documentation names known limits and does not imply a reuse license.
- [ ] Third-party sources and assets have explicit provenance and compatible
      terms, or are linked rather than copied.
